verdict.rationale: Langfuse's prompt management lets non-technical users edit prompts in the UI while apps fetch the latest version, supports versioning and labels for deploying across environments, links prompts to traces, and explicitly separates prompt iteration from code deployment ('product managers iterate on prompts, while engineers manage deployments'). This directly matches the story of versioning and deploying prompt changes without shipping code. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the deployment workflow, and one community note (langfuse-comm-11) flags prompt management as historically 'behind' compared to a competitor, indicating some feature maturity caveats.
